applicant.name: Mag. Peter Hollaus
applicant.organisation: Federal Ministry of Health, department for emergency care

purpose: Policy-making: assessing the pressure on emergency departments.
question: For 2025, what share of all hospital contacts in each hospital were emergency visits?
definitions: A contact is any encounter (inpatient, outpatient or emergency) that started in 2025; count contacts, not patients.
Hospital = the data holder of the encounter.
Report per hospital: all contacts, emergency visits, and emergency visits as % of all contacts, one decimal.
